milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The red nether brick stairs are placed in a 2x2 cluster at spawn-relative (~1-2, ~0, ~5-6). Target is the corner block at (2,0,6). max_distance=5 requires the player to approach within 5 blocks (spawn is ~6.3 blocks away, so player must move toward stairs). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the stairs, confirming visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The warped door is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 3) on the south wall of the nether brick structure. max_distance=5 requires the player to approach within 5 blocks (spawn is ~5.8 blocks away, so player must move toward door). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the door, confirming visual identification.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a lever results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must combine 1 stick (from the chest inside the structure) and 1 cobblestone (mined from the block inside the structure) to craft a lever. The lever is not in the starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful crafting.
